concerns.text: FR-001 cites “(See US-1)” but the document never defines a User Story with ID US‑1; the user stories are titled “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, etc. This cross‑reference is unresolved.
FR-003 cites “(See US-2)” yet no US‑2 identifier exists in the spec; the second user story is labeled “User Story 2”. The reference should be aligned with the actual ID.

FR-005 defines the sensitivity‑analysis set as `{5,000,, min_depth}` – the double comma creates a malformed set definition. Clarify the intended values (e.g., `{5,000, min_depth}` or an explicit range).
